cohort: Women undergoing vaginal delivery (including instrumental delivery) at 18 tertiary care hospitals in India.
finding: Episiotomy was performed in 63.4% of vaginal deliveries, and the rate of third/fourth degree perineal tears was significantly lower in nulliparous women who received episiotomy compared to those who did not.
mod_finding: Nulliparous women were 8.8 times more likely to undergo episiotomy than multiparous women, and the combined rate of third and fourth degree perineal tears was significantly lower among nullipara who received episiotomy compared to those who delivered without episiotomy.
